shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then cat ../round-brief.md; fi
cat .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- test command config ---\\n'
cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
git status --short
git log -1 --oneline
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,180p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,130p'
rg --files scripts | rg 'spec-links|anchor|lore'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts --runInBand
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm run spec:names
git status --short
git diff --check
git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "docs: repair usage test anchors" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status --short --branch && git push origin HEAD'
